title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Trio #21 (RussianPalekh+KoreanEunipsa+HungarianKalocsa+UkrainianPetrykivka / VasarelyOpArt+MexicanTalavera+EthiopianCrossLattice+JapaneseKutani / JapaneseMakie+MoroccanZellige+VietnameseSonMai+PortugueseAzulejo)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Thai woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, bold and confident, soft pastel-peach hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes. Long square nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds, wide gold bands, dense jewel-toned scenework) dominates one zone. Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework, wide bold silver bands, dense lattice fills) dominates the second zone. Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals, wide gold bands, dense folk-art floral motifs) dominates the third zone. Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers, wide gold bands, dense folk-art florals) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Left woman's footwear: extreme thigh-high stiletto boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, sultry, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands, dense optical illusion grid) dominates one zone. Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands, dense medallion scrollwork) dominates the second zone. Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework, wide gold bands, dense lattice linework) dominates the third zone. Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels, wide gold-and-red bands, dense overglaze florals) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised.

Center woman's footwear: extreme thigh-high stiletto boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Egyptian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, cheerful, cool ash-brown hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder, wide gold-powder bands, dense gold powder glittering densely) dominates one zone. Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs) dominates the second zone. Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, wide gold-leaf bands, dense eggshell-white scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands, dense repeating panel scrollwork) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.

Right woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform wedges, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
